|level21_strength_requirement = 159 |inventory_icon = Ancestral Protector |is_in_game = false |release_version = 2.2.0 |removal_version = 3.25.0 }} '''Ancestral Protector''' is a [[totem]] skill that creates an [[Ancestor Totem]] which will attack enemies with melee strikes while the player stands close to it. Being near it increases the player's attack speed. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== *'''Weapon''': Ancestral Protector targets single enemies at a greater range than the character's would grant. The totem can be supported by {{il|Melee Splash}} to hit several enemies at once. It can also be used while [[Unarmed]]. Additional strikes allow the totem to target multiple enemies at once. *'''Fortify''': Linking {{il|Fortify Support}} to Ancestral Protector will cause the totem, and not the player, to gain fortification on melee hit. Stats that let you gain fortification in certain conditions related to attacking (e.g. on hit, on melee stun) are also inherited by the totem. *'''Multiple Totems''': The attack speed buff does not stack when multiple totems are summoned. *'''Area of Effect''': Modifiers to skill radius have no effect on range at which totem stays active or the range of it's attack, even if supported by {{il|Melee Splash}}. It will affect the strike's splash damage area, however. *'''Activation''': The totem is active as long as the player remains within a 85 [[Distance|unit]] radius of it. Initial activation also requires line of sight with the player, but this can be broken once the totem has become active. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Attack
